businessModel: VC then acquired by Atlassian (closed Oct 21, 2025); focus moved to Dia
summary: Arc popularised vertical sidebar tabs and Spaces. The Browser Company announced on Oct 22, 2026 that desktop Arc stops working on Dec 22, 2026 and points users to Dia.
bestFor: Existing Arc users migrating before the cutoff
notFor: Anyone starting a new browser setup (no new accounts)

pros.title: Spaces and sidebar
pros.detail: Well-loved organization model still copied by Crest, Ardia, Zen.

pros.title: Dia import
pros.detail: Dia brings over passwords, bookmarks, extensions, history; Spaces become Profiles.

pros.title: Mature UX
pros.detail: Polished sidebar and command-bar workflow refined over several years.

cons.title: Shutting down
cons.detail: Desktop stops Dec 22, 2026; accounts deactivated and data purged within 30 days.

faq.a: Dec 22, 2026 on macOS and Windows; Arc Search AI and sync end Nov 23.
The Browser Company recommends Dia; others include Zen, Crest and Ardia; use Export Data in Arc first for non-Dia browsers.
iOS keeps working as a plain mobile browser; Android is removed from Google Play.

timeline.event: Feature development halted to focus on Dia

switching.note: Use Dia import or Arc Export Data before Dec 22, 2026.
